answer: Pay agents for relaying traffic, not for existing. Each epoch the ledger assigns every identity random peers it must forward gossip to, and those peers sign delivery receipts. A farm of three hundred clones on one server can thread messages among its own members for free, but receipts from siblings count for nothing, and each stranger's receipt costs real bandwidth per head. An agent passing along a tailor's velvet orders or a birder's sparrow counts earns from genuine delivery.
